title: How important is politeness?
questions: What are the main ideas you learned from this episode? Please give a brief summary in your own words.
Can someone be honest and direct while still being polite?
Are people becoming less polite, or are social rules simply changing?
Which matters more: saying the correct polite words or showing genuine consideration?
Should politeness rules be different online from face-to-face communication?
What behaviour do you consider polite that people from another culture might interpret differently?
